args.title: Saltmarsh Foods — Retail Returns Logistics Summary
args.body:
- Saltmarsh Foods’ latest newsletter highlights retail returns logistics and points readers to the feature article and its webinar companion piece.
- The article reports apparel return rates reaching 24% and says consolidated return hubs can reduce handling costs by about one-fifth.
- The companion piece says reselling returned goods within 10 days preserves most of the margin.
